purpose: Teach: 聴け/ダラダラ/働け/蹴っ/滑らか/呑み/噛ん/食費

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 授業中、先生の話、よく聴けば、理解できる。
lines.en: If you actually listen in class, you can understand what the teacher's saying.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Direct eye contact. She means this — not a lecture, a statement of fact. Slight lift at the end, like she's offering the truth and letting him take it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。夏休み、ダラダラ過ごすの、最高。
lines.en: Yeah. Summer break is literally made for just… checking out.
lines.style: Relaxed agreement with a tiny smile underneath. Leans back slightly. The comfortable tone of someone who doesn't feel judged for wanting to do nothing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: バイト、もう少し、働けば、目標金額、貯まる。
lines.en: If I pick up a few more shifts at work, I'll finally hit my savings target.
lines.style: Focused, almost to herself but including him. Determined without being stressed. A brief pause before 'target' — she's visualizing it working.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、サッカーで、ボール、思いきり蹴ったよ。
lines.en: Yesterday at soccer I absolutely smashed that ball.
lines.style: Sudden energy. Light, genuine satisfaction in the voice. Quick tempo on 'absolutely smashed.' The small thrill of a good play, not bragging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、衣装、滑らかな生地、選んだ。
lines.en: For the festival costume I picked out something with a really nice fabric.
lines.style: Soft, almost tactile. Running her hand over an imagined surface mentally as she speaks. Thoughtful pace. Pride in the choice without overselling it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活帰り、ジュース、ストローでぐっと呑み干した。
lines.en: On the way home from practice I downed this juice in one go.
lines.style: Casual recounting, tiny bit of self-aware humor about the greediness of it. Light rhythm. The comfortable randomness of someone sharing the small moment just because.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ガム、噛んでみる?気分転換に。
lines.en: Want to try some gum? Sometimes it helps me reset a little.
lines.style: Genuine offer, not performative. Soft and curious tone. A small gesture of inclusion — she's sharing something small because she notices he might need it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: I've been cutting back on food costs lately.
lines.style: Light surface but something careful underneath. Dry, almost self-deprecating. He's not complaining — just stating it, the way you do when you're handling something quietly and don't need sympathy.
